elements.manual_reason: The outlined 'Server' circle ends fully overlapped by the orb; the only candidate (b01) is the orb's diff box, already used, so the circle's settled position is drawn manually under the orb.
elements.label: 'Server' outline circle node

elements.manual_reason: Full-frame background tint has no candidate box; it warms from near-white to a soft pink haze as the circles merge.
elements.label: Background tint

pattern.description: The labelled 'Server' outline circle and the gradient agent orb slide toward each other to frame centre and merge into one orb; the 'Server' label fades as it is covered, the orb's palette shifts from green to coral, and the background takes on the orb's tint.
pattern.why_premium: Two diagram nodes physically fusing says 'connect your own server' without arrows or captions; the colour hand-off and background tint make the merge feel like a single continuous material, timed on the word 'server'.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: tl.to(serverCircle, {x: centerX, duration: 0.8, ease: 'power3.inOut'}, 0).to(orb, {x: centerX, duration: 0.8, ease: 'power3.inOut'}, 0).to(serverLabel, {opacity: 0, scale: 0.8, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.in'}, 0.15).to(orb, {'--hue-shift': 1, duration: 0.6, ease: 'sine.inOut'}, 0.2).to(bgTint, {opacity: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.out'}, 0.3). Orb keeps an independent infinite rotation (ease 'none'); serverCircle zIndex below orb.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 100}}) (no overshoot); serverX = interpolate(p, [0,1], [leftX, centerX]); orbX = interpolate(p, [0,1], [rightX, centerX]); labelOpacity = interpolate(frame, [4, 13], [1, 0], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); palette mix and bg tint driven by interpolate(p, [0.2, 1], [0, 1]).

notes: camera.move is none; scale 1.15 reflects the circles converging, not a zoom. Only one candidate box exists, so the Server circle and background use manual boxes. Background tint is subtle; may be a side effect of the orb glow rather than a separate animated layer.
